description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for handling recipe browsing, viewing, importing, and listing within a web application. It includes methods for listing recipes, viewing a specific recipe, importing recipes, and managing related project and user data.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Browse::Recipe
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for browsing recipes, handling actions like listing, viewing, and importing recipes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles listing recipes, including filtering based on user permissions and project associations, and prepares data for rendering.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures recipe ID and URL name, fetches the recipe from the database, and sets up the context for subsequent actions.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Prepares the import view for a specific recipe, listing projects available for importing, and generating relevant URLs.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a specific recipe, including ingredient details and related project information, with support for servings adjustment.
